May 26, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Greystone Managed Investments Inc increased its stake in Manulife Finl Corp (MFC) by 3.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greystone Managed Investments Inc bought 131,131 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.62% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.89 million shares of the life insurance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $81.46 million, up from 3.76M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greystone Managed Investments Inc who had been investing in Manulife Finl Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.96 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.78% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $19.2. About 1.18 million shares traded. Manulife Financial Corporation (NYSE:MFC) has risen 4.92% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.63% the S&P500.
